mapper.select:
SELECT se.no, se.title, se.open_date, se.close_date,
CASE WHEN es.no IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS subscribed
0 AS subscribed
FROM scheduled_exam se
LEFT JOIN exam_subscription es ON se.no = es.exam_no AND es.member_id = #{memberId}
WHERE open_date >= TO_DATE(#{year}||'-'||#{month}||'-01','YYYY-MM-DD') AND open_date < ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{year}||'-'||#{month}||'-01','YYYY-MM-DD'),1) ORDER BY open_date OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scheduled_exam WHERE open_date >= TO_DATE(#{year}||'-'||#{month}||'-01','YYYY-MM-DD') AND open_date < ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{year}||'-'||#{month}||'-01','YYYY-MM-DD'),1)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_subscription(member_id, exam_no, notified_d3, notified_dd) VALUES(#{memberId}, #{examNo}, 'N', 'N')
mapper.select: SELECT no AS examNo, title AS examTitle FROM scheduled_exam WHERE TRUNC(open_date) = TRUNC(SYSDATE + #{targetDate})
SELECT member_id FROM exam_subscription WHERE exam_no=#{examNo} AND ${column} = 'N'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM exam_subscription WHERE member_id=#{memberId} AND exam_no=#{examNo}
